blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Classes at all levels in public and private schools, as well as government work, in General Santos City will be suspended until further notice following the magnitude 5.6 earthquake off Davao Occidental. In an advisory, the General Santos government said the suspension of government work will take effect Thursday, Oct. 8. Meanwhile, in-person classes at all levels in both public and private schools in the city are suspended on Friday, Oct. 9. Classes will shift to an alternative mode of learning.
